title: Return the Relic
description: The relic is back, and whole. Return it to Gaela's priestess in Dalhurst so she has it in hand before the planting.

objectives.description: Return the relic to the priestess before the planting

notes: Closing beat delivers the relic in time. No branch exists for arriving late; the deadline is prose pressure only, recorded here as a second path (a failed-blessing outcome) this pass could not wire.
